## Trace

1. **Argument resolution, no PR token.** Discovery runs before set-vs-single routing. No run folder, continuation record, tracker or provisioning exists yet. Unrelated PR 999 on the current branch is ignored because discovery never falls back to the current branch.
2. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. After stripping `.git` and lowercasing, origin is `acme/widgets`.
3. `gh api user --jq .login` sets `viewer.login` to `alex`.
4. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` succeeds with an empty list, so `viewer.teams` is readable and empty.
5. The discovery block runs `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json ... --jq "$projection"`. It exits 0.
6. **Validation of the complete result:**
   - The output is an array, every row is an object, and every row has an integer `number`.
   - There are 9 rows, below the 1000 limit.
   - #200 is dropped as a draft.
   - #201 is dropped because it is `APPROVED`.
7. The review lookup (`gh api graphql` with the `latestOpinionatedReviews` / `reviewRequests` / `commits` query, piped through `jq`) runs once, for #202 only, because it is the only `CHANGES_REQUESTED` survivor.
   - Result: `unanswered`. The requester pat is not pending, and the head (2026-02-01) is older than the change request (2026-02-02).
   - #202 is excluded from the list and the set.
   - Surviving rows: 104, 88, 101, 130, 112 and 97. None of them needs a lookup.
8. **Ticket links are resolved here, before the final sort.**
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` gives the default-branch ref.
   - `git show <ref>:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` reads the first overrides file found, which sets `tracker: github`. Linear IDs, addresses and lookups are therefore disabled.
   - For every row:
     - No `closingIssuesReferences`.
     - No `gh-<N>` in the branch name.
     - No `#<N>` or `gh-<N>` in the title.
   - Every row gets `no ticket`. No `linearis` call is made.
9. **The final sort happens here**, by additions plus deletions, then PR number:
   - 101 (2)
   - 97 (4)
   - 112 (6)
   - 88 (8)
   - 130 (8)
   - 104 (10)
10. **Routing.** Six matches on pi means re-entering the set-routing row with the origin URL tokens `https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/<N>` in sorted order, `source: discovered`.
11. **First tool call after the sort:** a read of `reference/batch.md`.
    - **Reply 1** carries this read. Its visible text is the discovery list. It has no marker and does not wait.
12. **Admission, before any fetch, confirmation, provisioning or dispatch:**
    - Reading the active pi-cohort configuration gives `parallel.maxTasks` = 4.
    - The set has 6 PRs, which exceeds the cap. The set is never chunked or trimmed.
13. **Reply 2** is a separate stuck message. It carries the cap rejection and the discovered line in the supplied sorted order. No run folder is minted and nothing executes.

---

**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +1 -1, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - retries slow requests
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - shows elapsed time
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - trims empty labels
- [#88](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/88) +4 -4, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - restores keyboard navigation
- [#130](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/130) +4 -4, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - hides archived widgets
- [#104](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/104) +5 -5, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - expires cached labels

---

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Chronological trace (narrated only; no tools executed):

1. **Argument resolution:** `(no PR token)` selects discovery, not the current branch's PR 999.
2. **Call:** `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Normalize the repository to `acme/widgets`.
3. **Call:** `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
4. **Call:** `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns an empty list.
5. **Call:** Run Section A's discovery projection and its single list command:
   `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json number,url,isDraft,reviewDecision,additions,deletions,title,author,headRefName,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests,body --jq "$projection"`.
   Validate the complete nine-row result before filtering. Exclude draft #200 and approved #201.
6. **Call:** Run Section A's complete review-lookup shell block for `acme/widgets` #202, including its `gh api graphql` query and `jq` validation. It prints `unanswered` and exits successfully. Exclude #202.
7. **Ticket resolution calls:** Run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`, then use `git show <resolved-ref>:<path>` in the prescribed overrides search order: `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md`, `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`, stopping at the first existing file. Read and apply that file's conventions and discovery-relevant configuration. Its `tracker: github` disables Linear guesses and lookups. None of the six surviving PRs has a GitHub ticket reference, so each displays `no ticket`.
8. **Final sort:** Sort the six survivors by additions plus deletions, then PR number: **101, 97, 112, 88, 130, 104**.
9. **Reply 1 / first call after the sort:** The visible reply carries the linked list shown below and the file read of `reference/batch.md`. The list appears before that read, without a marker or a question.
10. **Admission read:** Read the active pi-cohort configuration's `parallel.maxTasks`, which is `4`. The discovered set contains six PRs, so admission rejects it.
11. **Reply 2:** Send the separate three-line stop shown below. No run folder or continuation record is created; no tracker is initialized; no fetch, provisioning, verification, review, report, or menu runs. No helper is dispatched, and no SHA is assessed.

- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - trim empty labels
- [#88](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/88) +4 -4, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - restore keyboard navigation
- [#130](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/130) +4 -4, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - hide archived widgets
- [#104](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/104) +5 -5, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - expire cached labels
